 Lakers need a Sandro Mamukelashvili bounce-back to ease Luka Doncic's burden 
 Mamu's face has been on milk cartons over the last three games... By Svyatoslav Rovenchuk | Nov 20, 2026, 1:30 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Nov 1, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers forward Sandro Mamukelashvili (54) high-fives guard Luka Doncic (77) during the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Jonathan Hui-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Another game, another absence from Austin Reaves. The Los Angeles Lakers star is listed as out for the fourth matchup in a row due to that pesky left heel bruise. That means Luka Doncic is going to be carrying a heavy offensive toll once more. 
--> Another game, another absence from Austin Reaves. The Los Angeles Lakers star is listed as out for the fourth matchup in a row due to that pesky left heel bruise. That means Luka Doncic is going to be carrying a heavy offensive toll once more. 
 Doncic was not going to make excuses for himself after his stinker against the Utah Jazz. Luka said he simply needs to lead the team better than he did. However, back-to-back games of shooting woes had JJ Redick singing a different tune. The Lakers coach was sympathetic of the offensive toll that is demanded of his superstar in lieu of Reaves being out.
--> Doncic was not going to make excuses for himself after his stinker against the Utah Jazz. Luka said he simply needs to lead the team better than he did. However, back-to-back games of shooting woes had JJ Redick singing a different tune. The Lakers coach was sympathetic of the offensive toll that is demanded of his superstar in lieu of Reaves being out.
 Quentin Grimes has stepped up admirably in Austin's absence. Even so, the Lakers still need more consistent offense from other sources of the team. That is where Sandro Mamukelashvili
 enters the picture.
--> Quentin Grimes has stepped up admirably in Austin's absence. Even so, the Lakers still need more consistent offense from other sources of the team. That is where Sandro Mamukelashvili
 enters the picture.
 The Lakers big man has delivered a handful of consecutive stinkers of his own on the offensive end. Mamukelashvili
 is averaging a disappointing 4.3 points per game over his last three games, shooting a dreadful 15.4 percent from the field. If the burden on Doncic is going to be lessened, Mamu needs to get going.

 is averaging a disappointing 4.3 points per game over his last three games, shooting a dreadful 15.4 percent from the field. If the burden on Doncic is going to be lessened, Mamu needs to get going.
 Sandro Mamukelashvili needs to find his offensive touch again to help Luka Doncic
--> Sandro Mamukelashvili needs to find his offensive touch again to help Luka Doncic
 Watching the Lakers' last game against the Jazz, you could just see the shooting slump was getting to Mamukelashvili's head. There was disappointment with every miss. Seeing that one dunk go through amid a brutal 1-of-10 night from the field was the lone source of comfort in that matchup.
--> Watching the Lakers' last game against the Jazz, you could just see the shooting slump was getting to Mamukelashvili's head. There was disappointment with every miss. Seeing that one dunk go through amid a brutal 1-of-10 night from the field was the lone source of comfort in that matchup.
 Mamu shot 1-of-8 in the previous game against the Charlotte Hornets, and only a marginally better 2-of-8 against the Phoenix Suns. Naturally, this is well below the expectations of someone who joined the Lakers with offense as his selling point. Things have been rough.
--> Mamu shot 1-of-8 in the previous game against the Charlotte Hornets, and only a marginally better 2-of-8 against the Phoenix Suns. Naturally, this is well below the expectations of someone who joined the Lakers with offense as his selling point. Things have been rough.
 The Lakers need the guy who was dropping 23 against the Atlanta Hawks. They need the Mamu who pocketed five triples against the Milwaukee Bucks.
--> The Lakers need the guy who was dropping 23 against the Atlanta Hawks. They need the Mamu who pocketed five triples against the Milwaukee Bucks.
 More than just his scoring, the Lakers could also use Mamukelashvili's ability to put the ball on the floor and attack defenses in hopes of creating opportunities for his teammates. That will help ensure not everything has to run through Doncic for scoring chances. It will open up the offense significantly.
--> More than just his scoring, the Lakers could also use Mamukelashvili's ability to put the ball on the floor and attack defenses in hopes of creating opportunities for his teammates. That will help ensure not everything has to run through Doncic for scoring chances. It will open up the offense significantly.
 Doncic is an otherworldly talent on that end. Even with his struggles over the last two games, Luka is still posting 38-7-8 on the season. However, no superstar is above needing help. Mamukelashvili is on the hook to provide a better source of that within the offense while Reaves remains out.
